hook_variants.template: Sharks are older than trees. Think about that.
What existed first: sharks or trees?
450 million years. That's how long sharks have been around.

sections.text: Sharks have been on Earth for over 400 million years. Trees showed up around 350 million years ago.
They swam the oceans for about 50 million years before the first tree existed.
sections.title: the timeline

sections.text: They survived ice ages, mass extinctions, and the dinosaurs.
sections.title: survivors

sections.text: Their basic body plan hasn't changed in about 200 million years.
sections.subtitle: years of the same winning design

sections.text: So yes, the ocean was doing fine before the forest even existed.
Follow for more facts that rearrange your sense of time.

facts.claim: Sharks first appeared in the fossil record over 400 million years ago, in the early Devonian
Trees appeared around 350-360 million years ago in the Carboniferous period
Sharks survived all five major mass extinction events
